title: Month-end audit support package
prompt: Compile a month-end audit support package from the trial balance, account schedules, reconciliations and journal-entry support.

setup.q: How does the auditor want the package laid out (one file per account, one binder, their request list numbering)?
Which accounts does the package cover? Leave blank for every balance sheet account with a balance.

inputs.name: Audit engagement artifacts and request list
Document vault files for the period
Reconciliations and schedules kept outside Dime

steps: pull the as-of trial balance for the last closed month and fix the account list from accountsInScope (or every balance sheet account with a balance)
for each account, collect the schedule, reconciliation and journal-entry support Dime holds (workpapers, bank reconciliations, audit engagement artifacts, vault files, report packages)
for each journal entry in the month over the flag threshold the engagement sets, locate its support document
list every account or entry with no support found as a missing-support item with where support was looked for
write the package index in the auditor's format and the workbook

done.text: The Detail sheet lists every account in scope with its period-end balance, and the total ties to Dime's trial balance as of the period end
Every exception row is a missing-support item and cites the account id or journal id and the last place support was looked for
audit-support-package.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
The package index follows the auditor's requested format; support the desk could not reach is told apart from support that does not exist; nothing is sent to the auditor
